read.thesis: Colgate's Q3 organic sales rose 3.6% with 300bp material inflation offset by 290bp productivity; FY gross margin guide raised to up, but management flags headwinds from resins and logistics into 2027.

triggers.label: Pricing ~200bp in Q3
triggers.quote: we generated 220 basis points of pricing, 160 in the second quarter, and 200 more or less in the third quarter

triggers.label: FY gross margin now up
triggers.quote: we guided for margin to be up on a year-on-year basis, up from roughly flat previously

triggers.label: Cost inflation ~$300m held
triggers.quote: I would say roughly, it is still in the same original range of $300± million

triggers.label: North America volumes -3.7%
triggers.quote: North America Organic Sales -- 1.6% decline, as a 2.2% price increase was insufficient to offset a 3.7% decline in volumes.

guidance.quote: Full-Year Net Sales Guidance -- 4% to 5% growth, representing a narrowing of the previous range of 2% to 6%.
Full-Year Base Business EPS Guidance -- 5% to 7% growth, raised from the company's previous mid-single-digit growth expectations.
we guided for margin to be up on a year-on-year basis, up from roughly flat previously

red_flags.label: North America volume decline 3.7%
red_flags.quote: a 2.2% price increase was insufficient to offset a 3.7% decline in volumes

red_flags.label: Advertising up to 14.4% of sales
red_flags.quote: $775 million, representing 14.4% of net sales compared to 13.1% in the prior year

evasions.quote: we won't be sharing guidance on 2027 until the first quarter of next year
we are not going to necessarily guide to where we are in 2027 with regards to pricing
